name: ティーライフ株式会社
特種東海製紙株式会社
parentNote: Holding company formed from 2007 merger of Tokai Pulp and Tokushu Seishi. Independently listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (3708). 15 subsidiaries, 5 affiliated companies.

name: 株式会社桜井製作所
parentNote: Sakurai Ltd. is the parent company of a small group (2 subsidiaries + 1 related company). No external operating parent.

name: エイケン工業
株式会社ローランド（Roland）
parentNote: Independent operating parent. Founded April 18, 1972 by Ikutaro Kakehashi. 18 consolidated subsidiaries including Drum Workshop (acquired 2022) and BOSS. Current CEO Masahiro Minowa (not founding family). Founder Kakehashi deceased April 2017.

name: 焼津水産化学工業株式会社
parentNote: Subsidiary of いなば食品株式会社 (acquired March 28, 2024 via YJホールディングス/Jump Life TOB; delisted June 6, 2024). Parent HQ: 静岡県静岡市清水区由比北田114-1 (also in Shizuoka).

name: パーパス株式会社
parentNote: Subsidiary of パーパスホールディングス (Purpose Holdings, also Shizuoka-based). Operating entity for manufacturing and technology division.

name: 株式会社静岡朝日テレビ
株式会社テレビ静岡
parentNote: Equity method affiliate of Fuji Media Holdings (FMH HQ in Tokyo). FMH is a holding company, not an operating parent. 21.0% ownership by FMH as of Feb 2026. Also 14.3% by Shizuoka Railway. Listed as 持分法適用関連会社 (equity method affiliate), not subsidiary (子会社).

name: ヤマハモーターソリューション株式会社
parentNote: 100% subsidiary of Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd. (parent HQ: Iwata, Shizuoka)

name: ローム浜松株式会社
parentNote: Subsidiary (子会社) of ローム株式会社 (ROHM Semiconductor), HQ in Kyoto. Dissolved/merged April 21, 2026 into ローム・デバイス マニュファクチャリング (registered HQ in Kyoto, not Shizuoka).

name: 株式会社遠鉄ストア
parentNote: 100% owned by 遠州鉄道株式会社 (Entetsu Railway Co., Ltd.), a family conglomerate holding parent also HQ'd in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka; qualifies as independent per 〇〇ホールディングス family parent rule

name: 医療法人弘遠会
parentNote: Independent medical corporation; no parent company relationship identified

name: 株式会社スズキ部品製造
parentNote: 100% subsidiary of Suzuki Motor Corporation (parent also based in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka)

name: 近物レックス株式会社
parentNote: 子会社：株式会社ハマキョウレックス(浜松市中央区)が73%保有。親会社は3PL物流事業の営業企業だが、同じ静岡県内に所在

name: 株式会社イカイコントラクト
parentNote: Subsidiary of 株式会社イカイ (Ikai Co., Ltd.) headquartered in Numazu, Shizuoka. Parent is operating/事業持株会社 structure. Both company and parent are in Shizuoka Prefecture, so meets independence requirement.

name: 株式会社イカイアウトソーシング
parentNote: Subsidiary of 株式会社イカイ (parent also HQ in Shizuoka, operating company)

name: 一般財団法人芙蓉協会
parentNote: Related organization (関連法人) of 社会福祉法人聖隷福祉事業団 (HQ: Hamamatsu, Shizuoka). Maintains independent legal entity status as 一般財団法人.

name: 株式会社駿河屋
parentNote: Multiple strategic investors (Geo Holdings, Nihon Hanbai Group Holdings, Marui Group) but no operating parent outside Shizuoka. Founder-led independent firm.

name: 静岡トヨタ自動車株式会社
parentNote: 100% subsidiary of Entetsu Railway (遠州鉄道, HQ in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Pref). Parent is in-prefecture operating company.

name: 株式会社メンテックカンザイ
parentNote: Family-owned. MTK Holdings Co., Ltd. created 2013 as family holding company (独立系ホールディングス).

name: 鈴与建設株式会社
parentNote: Subsidiary of 鈴与コンストラクションホールディングス (holding company, HQ also in Shimizu-ku, Shizuoka). Part of Suzuyo Group (鈴与グループ) under 鈴与ホールディングス family holding.

name: 株式会社フジドリームエアラインズ
parentNote: Subsidiary of Suzuyo Co., Ltd. (100% owned), which is a Shizuoka-based operating company. Does not trigger dependent status per rules (parent based IN Shizuoka, not outside).

name: しずてつジャストライン株式会社
parentNote: 100% subsidiary of Shizuoka Railway Co., Ltd. (parent HQ also in Shizuoka Prefecture,葵区鷹匠一丁目1番1号)

name: 清水食品株式会社
parentNote: Subsidiary of Suzuyo Co., Ltd. (鈴与株式会社), a Suzuki-family operating company also based in Shizuoka. Functions as asset management company for SSK brand factories/equipment.

name: 中村建設株式会社
parentNote: Independent parent company with 4 subsidiaries: Tokai Urban Development (東海アーバン開発), Tokai Disaster Prevention (東海防災), Field Service (フィールド・サービス), and Kanemtsu Quarry (兼松採石)

name: 株式会社出雲殿互助会
parentNote: Sister company within 出雲殿グループ (founded 2005); not a subsidiary of an operating parent outside Shizuoka

name: 株式会社エキスパートパワーシズオカ
parentNote: Subsidiary of 株式会社イカイ (Ikaigumi), holding company based in Shizuoka (沼津市). Not dependent per criteria since parent is Shizuoka-based.

name: 伊豆箱根交通株式会社
parentNote: Subsidiary of Izu Hakone Railway (伊豆算根鉄道, HQ in Mishima, Shizuoka). Izu Hakone Railway is 84.51% owned by Seibu Railway (HQ Tokorozawa, Saitama / Minami-Ikebukuro, Tokyo). However, the operating parent (Izu Hakone Railway) is based in Shizuoka, making this company independent within Shizuoka scope.

name: 丸富製紙株式会社
